get_CLAP_model: load a CLAP audio-text model from a checkpoint file or HuggingFace Hub
create_ClapRanker: create a ClapRanker instance with a ClapRankerConfig to rank audio against text descriptions
prepare_audio_features: prepare audio tensors by resampling to 48kHz and extracting LAION CLAP audio features
rank_audio_with_descriptions: compute similarity scores between audio candidates and text descriptions using CLAP embeddings
forward_ClapRanker: run the ClapRanker forward pass to score audio candidates against text descriptions
